entries: What is the full form of CEO?
**CEO** stands for **Chief Executive Officer**: the top boss of a company.
What is the full form of CFO?
**CFO** stands for **Chief Financial Officer**: the head of a company's money matters.
What is the full form of HR?
**HR** stands for **Human Resources**: the team that hires and looks after employees.
What is the full form of ATM?
**ATM** stands for **Automated Teller Machine**: a machine for taking cash out of your bank account.
What is the full form of PIN?
**PIN** stands for **Personal Identification Number**: a secret number for cards and accounts.
What is the full form of OTP?
**OTP** stands for **One Time Password**: a code that works only once, sent to your phone to confirm who you are.
What is the full form of PAN?
**PAN** stands for **Permanent Account Number**: India's 10-character tax ID, given by the Income Tax Department.
What is the full form of GST?
**GST** stands for **Goods and Services Tax**: India's single tax on goods and services, started on 1 July 2017.
What is the full form of IFSC?
**IFSC** stands for **Indian Financial System Code**: an 11-character code that identifies a bank branch for transfers.
What is the full form of NEFT?
**NEFT** stands for **National Electronic Funds Transfer**: a way to send money between Indian bank accounts.
What is the full form of RTGS?
**RTGS** stands for **Real Time Gross Settlement**: instant transfer of large amounts (₹2 lakh or more) between banks.
What is the full form of IMPS?
**IMPS** stands for **Immediate Payment Service**: instant money transfer in India, any time of day.
What is the full form of KYC?
**KYC** stands for **Know Your Customer**: checking a customer's identity with documents like Aadhaar and PAN.
What is the full form of EMI?
**EMI** stands for **Equated Monthly Instalment**: the fixed amount you pay every month to repay a loan.
What is the full form of GDP?
**GDP** stands for **Gross Domestic Product**: the total value of everything a country produces in a year.
What is the full form of RBI?
**RBI** stands for **Reserve Bank of India**: India's central bank, set up in 1935.
What is the full form of SBI?
**SBI** stands for **State Bank of India**: India's largest bank.
What is the full form of LIC?
**LIC** stands for **Life Insurance Corporation of India**: India's largest life insurance company.
What is the full form of NASA?
**NASA** stands for **National Aeronautics and Space Administration**: the US space agency.
What is the full form of ISRO?
**ISRO** stands for **Indian Space Research Organisation**: India's space agency, based in Bengaluru, founded in 1969.
What is the full form of DRDO?
**DRDO** stands for **Defence Research and Development Organisation**: India's defence research agency.
What is the full form of UNO?
**UNO** stands for **United Nations Organisation**: the world body of 193 countries, founded in 1945.
What is the full form of UNESCO?
**UNESCO** stands for **United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization**: the UN agency for education, science and culture; it lists World Heritage Sites.
What is the full form of UNICEF?
**UNICEF** stands for **United Nations International Children's Emergency Fund**: the UN agency that helps children.
What is the full form of WHO?
**WHO** stands for **World Health Organization**: the UN agency for health, based in Geneva.
What is the full form of WTO?
**WTO** stands for **World Trade Organization**: the body that sets rules for trade between countries.
What is the full form of IMF?
**IMF** stands for **International Monetary Fund**: an international body that helps countries with money problems.
What is the full form of NATO?
**NATO** stands for **North Atlantic Treaty Organization**: a military alliance of North American and European countries.
What is the full form of FIFA?
**FIFA** stands for **Fédération Internationale de Football Association**: the world body for football.
What is the full form of ICC?
**ICC** stands for **International Cricket Council**: the world body for cricket.
What is the full form of BCCI?
**BCCI** stands for **Board of Control for Cricket in India**: the body that runs cricket in India.
What is the full form of IPL?
**IPL** stands for **Indian Premier League**: India's T20 cricket league, started in 2008.
What is the full form of IAS?
**IAS** stands for **Indian Administrative Service**: India's top civil service; officers are chosen through the UPSC exam.
What is the full form of IPS?
**IPS** stands for **Indian Police Service**: the service for senior police officers in India.
What is the full form of IFS?
**IFS** stands for **Indian Foreign Service**: the service for India's diplomats (also Indian Forest Service).
What is the full form of UPSC?
**UPSC** stands for **Union Public Service Commission**: the body that conducts the civil services exam.
What is the full form of TNPSC?
**TNPSC** stands for **Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission**: the body that recruits for Tamil Nadu government jobs.
What is the full form of NEET?
**NEET** stands for **National Eligibility cum Entrance Test**: the entrance exam for medical courses like MBBS.
What is the full form of JEE?
**JEE** stands for **Joint Entrance Examination**: the entrance exam for engineering (NITs and IITs).
What is the full form of IIT?
**IIT** stands for **Indian Institute of Technology**: India's top engineering institutes; the first was IIT Kharagpur (1951).
What is the full form of NIT?
**NIT** stands for **National Institute of Technology**: a group of top government engineering colleges.
What is the full form of CBSE?
**CBSE** stands for **Central Board of Secondary Education**: a national school board in India.
What is the full form of ICSE?
**ICSE** stands for **Indian Certificate of Secondary Education**: the class 10 exam of the CISCE board.
What is the full form of NCERT?
**NCERT** stands for **National Council of Educational Research and Training**: the body that makes school textbooks in India.
What is the full form of UGC?
**UGC** stands for **University Grants Commission**: the body that oversees universities in India.
What is the full form of MBBS?
**MBBS** stands for **Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery**: the basic degree to become a doctor.
What is the full form of MBA?
**MBA** stands for **Master of Business Administration**: a degree in business and management.
What is the full form of B.Tech?
**B.Tech** stands for **Bachelor of Technology**: a 4-year engineering degree.
What is the full form of PhD?
**PhD** stands for **Doctor of Philosophy**: the highest research degree.
What is the full form of MLA?
**MLA** stands for **Member of the Legislative Assembly**: an elected member of a state's assembly.
What is the full form of MP?
**MP** stands for **Member of Parliament**: an elected member of the Lok Sabha or a member of the Rajya Sabha.
What is the full form of PM?
**PM** stands for **Prime Minister**: the head of the government.
What is the full form of CM?
**CM** stands for **Chief Minister**: the head of a state government.
What is the full form of EVM?
**EVM** stands for **Electronic Voting Machine**: the machine used to vote in Indian elections.
What is the full form of NOTA?
**NOTA** stands for **None Of The Above**: the voting option to reject all candidates.
What is the full form of FIR?
**FIR** stands for **First Information Report**: the first written police report of a crime.
What is the full form of RTI?
**RTI** stands for **Right to Information**: a law (2005) that lets citizens ask the government for information.
What is the full form of PIL?
**PIL** stands for **Public Interest Litigation**: a court case filed for the public good.
What is the full form of GPS?
**GPS** stands for **Global Positioning System**: satellite navigation that tells your location.
What is the full form of SIM?
**SIM** stands for **Subscriber Identity Module**: the card that connects your phone to a mobile network.
What is the full form of Wi-Fi?
**Wi-Fi** stands for **Wireless Fidelity**: wireless networking that connects devices to the internet (the name is a brand, not a real abbreviation).
What is the full form of LED?
**LED** stands for **Light Emitting Diode**: a small, energy-saving light.
What is the full form of LCD?
**LCD** stands for **Liquid Crystal Display**: a flat screen used in TVs, monitors and calculators.
What is the full form of PDF?
**PDF** stands for **Portable Document Format**: a file type that looks the same on every device.
What is the full form of JPEG?
**JPEG** stands for **Joint Photographic Experts Group**: a common photo file format.
What is the full form of PNG?
**PNG** stands for **Portable Network Graphics**: an image format that keeps sharp edges and transparency.
What is the full form of GIF?
**GIF** stands for **Graphics Interchange Format**: an image format that can move (animate).
What is the full form of MP3?
**MP3** stands for **MPEG Audio Layer 3**: a common music file format.
What is the full form of MP4?
**MP4** stands for **MPEG-4 Part 14**: a common video file format.
What is the full form of OS?
**OS** stands for **Operating System**: the main software that runs a computer or phone, like Windows or Android.
What is the full form of GUI?
**GUI** stands for **Graphical User Interface**: the windows, icons and buttons you click on.
What is the full form of API?
**API** stands for **Application Programming Interface**: a set of rules that lets programs talk to each other.
What is the full form of SQL?
**SQL** stands for **Structured Query Language**: the language for working with databases.
What is the full form of CSS?
**CSS** stands for **Cascading Style Sheets**: the language for styling web pages.
What is the full form of PHP?
**PHP** stands for **Hypertext Preprocessor**: a language for building websites on servers.
What is the full form of IoT?
**IoT** stands for **Internet of Things**: everyday devices connected to the internet, like smart bulbs and watches.
What is the full form of VR?
**VR** stands for **Virtual Reality**: a computer-made 3D world you see through a headset.
What is the full form of AR?
**AR** stands for **Augmented Reality**: computer images added on top of the real world, like phone filters.
What is the full form of SSD?
**SSD** stands for **Solid State Drive**: fast storage with no moving parts.
What is the full form of HDD?
**HDD** stands for **Hard Disk Drive**: storage that uses spinning magnetic disks.
What is the full form of GPU?
**GPU** stands for **Graphics Processing Unit**: the chip that draws images and runs AI.
What is the full form of ALU?
**ALU** stands for **Arithmetic Logic Unit**: the part of the CPU that does maths and logic.
What is the full form of LAN?
**LAN** stands for **Local Area Network**: a network in one building or campus.
What is the full form of WAN?
**WAN** stands for **Wide Area Network**: a network over a large area; the internet is the biggest.
What is the full form of ISP?
**ISP** stands for **Internet Service Provider**: the company that gives you internet, like Jio or Airtel.
What is the full form of VPN?
**VPN** stands for **Virtual Private Network**: an encrypted tunnel for internet traffic.
What is the full form of WWW?
**WWW** stands for **World Wide Web**: the system of web pages on the internet, invented by Tim Berners-Lee in 1989.
What is the full form of DNS?
**DNS** stands for **Domain Name System**: the internet's phone book that turns names like google.com into addresses.
What is the full form of ECG?
**ECG** stands for **Electrocardiogram**: a test that records the heart's electrical activity.
What is the full form of MRI?
**MRI** stands for **Magnetic Resonance Imaging**: a scan that uses magnets and radio waves to see inside the body.
What is the full form of CT scan?
**CT scan** stands for **Computed Tomography scan**: an X-ray scan that makes detailed pictures of the inside of the body.
what does ct scan stand for
What is the full form of ICU?
**ICU** stands for **Intensive Care Unit**: the hospital ward for very sick patients.
What is the full form of BP?
**BP** stands for **Blood Pressure**: the push of blood on the walls of arteries; normal is about 120/80 mmHg.
What is the full form of BMI?
**BMI** stands for **Body Mass Index**: weight (kg) ÷ height (m)²; 18.5 to 24.9 is healthy.
What is the full form of HIV?
**HIV** stands for **Human Immunodeficiency Virus**: the virus that weakens the immune system and can cause AIDS.
What is the full form of AIDS?
**AIDS** stands for **Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome**: the late stage of HIV infection.
What is the full form of RNA?
**RNA** stands for **Ribonucleic Acid**: a molecule that carries genetic messages in cells.
What is the full form of ATP?
**ATP** stands for **Adenosine Triphosphate**: the energy molecule of living cells.
What is the full form of pH?
**pH** stands for **potential of Hydrogen**: the scale of how acidic or basic something is (0 to 14; 7 is neutral).
What is the full form of LPG?
**LPG** stands for **Liquefied Petroleum Gas**: cooking gas in cylinders (mostly propane and butane).
What is the full form of CNG?
**CNG** stands for **Compressed Natural Gas**: a cleaner fuel for vehicles (mostly methane).
What is the full form of AC?
**AC** stands for **Alternating Current**: electricity whose direction keeps changing; home supply in India is 230 V at 50 Hz (also: air conditioner).
What is the full form of DC?
**DC** stands for **Direct Current**: electricity that flows one way, as from a battery.
What is the full form of UPS?
**UPS** stands for **Uninterruptible Power Supply**: a battery backup that keeps devices running during a power cut.
What is the full form of AQI?
**AQI** stands for **Air Quality Index**: a number showing how clean or polluted the air is; 0 to 50 is good.
What is the full form of ISBN?
**ISBN** stands for **International Standard Book Number**: the unique number of a book.
What is the full form of ISO?
**ISO** stands for **International Organization for Standardization**: the body that sets international standards.
What is the full form of BIS?
**BIS** stands for **Bureau of Indian Standards**: India's standards body; it gives the ISI mark.
What is the full form of FSSAI?
**FSSAI** stands for **Food Safety and Standards Authority of India**: the body that checks food safety in India.
What is the full form of AIIMS?
**AIIMS** stands for **All India Institute of Medical Sciences**: India's top medical institutes; the first is in New Delhi.
What is the full form of IRCTC?
**IRCTC** stands for **Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation**: Indian Railways' ticket booking and catering company.
What is the full form of PNR?
**PNR** stands for **Passenger Name Record**: the 10-digit number of a train or flight booking.
What is the full form of RAC?
**RAC** stands for **Reservation Against Cancellation**: a train ticket status that shares a berth until a seat frees up.
What is the full form of ETA?
**ETA** stands for **Estimated Time of Arrival**: when something is expected to arrive.
What is the full form of FAQ?
**FAQ** stands for **Frequently Asked Questions**: a list of common questions with answers.
What is the full form of ASAP?
What is the full form of DIY?
**DIY** stands for **Do It Yourself**: making or fixing something yourself.
What is the full form of CCTV?
**CCTV** stands for **Closed-Circuit Television**: security cameras recording to a private system.
What is the full form of NGO?
**NGO** stands for **Non-Governmental Organisation**: a non-profit group that works for a social cause.
What is the full form of NCC?
**NCC** stands for **National Cadet Corps**: the youth wing of India's armed forces for students.
What is the full form of NSS?
**NSS** stands for **National Service Scheme**: a student volunteer programme for community service.
What is the full form of a.m. and p.m.?
**a.m. and p.m.** stands for **ante meridiem and post meridiem**: Latin for before midday and after midday.
full form of a.m. and p.m.
what does a.m. and p.m. stand for
What is the full form of etc.?
**etc.** stands for **et cetera**: Latin for and the rest.
What is the full form of e.g. and i.e.?
**e.g. and i.e.** stands for **exempli gratia (for example) and id est (that is)**: both come from Latin.
full form of e.g. and i.e.
what does e.g. and i.e. stand for
What is the full form of BC and AD?
**BC and AD** stands for **Before Christ and Anno Domini (in the year of the Lord)**: also written BCE and CE: Before Common Era and Common Era.
full form of bc and ad
what does bc and ad stand for
